name: Jeff Oliver
fact: He ran for student government vice president in the spring 1996 election as Andy Spears' running mate. The Herald's candidate round-up of 28 March 1996 calls him "Bowling Green junior Jeff Oliver, Spears' running mate". Spears lost the presidency to Kristen Miller.

name: Joe Morel
fact: He was SGA's sergeant-at-arms in the autumn of 1998. The Herald's report on Congress losing a quarter of its membership calls him "Joe Morel, sergeant of arms" and quotes him blaming the drop in attendance on meaningless debate.

name: Tim Gilbert
fact: He sat on SGA's legislative research committee in the autumn of 1998; the Herald introduces him as "Tim Gilbert, a member of the legislative research committee" in its report on falling Congress attendance.

name: Adam Howard
fact: He sat in Congress for the sophomore class in 1998-99. Writing to the Herald in March 1999 about the university's alternating-Friday timetable he described himself as speaking for "the opinions of sophomores that I represent in the Student Government Association", and signed the letter Adam C. Howard, Florence sophomore.
